title: chaenomeles × superba f. alba
intro: Chaenomeles × superba f. alba, commonly known as the flowering quince, is a deciduous shrub belonging to the Rosaceae family. This plant is valued for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of digestive issues, skin problems, and respiratory diseases. The therapeutic actions of Chaenomeles × superba f. alba include its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce fever, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
